newsitem.title: JAPAN: Small Japan tanker spills gasoline after collision.
newsitem.headline: Small Japan tanker spills gasoline after collision.

text.p: A coastal tanker collided with an empty liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) vessel off Japan's southern island of Kyushu on Wednesday morning, spilling at least 20 kilolitres (kl) of gasoline, maritime authorities said.

The collision between the two domestic vessels took place four km off the Kunisaki Peninsula, northern Kyushu, at 11.10 a.m. (0210 GMT) on Wednesday, a spokesman for the regional headquarters of the Maritime Safety Agency said.
It was unclear if the tanker, which was carrying 630 kl of gasoline, had stopped leaking gasoline, he said.
No one was injured in the accident, he added.
